answer: Stake-bonded identity with independent attestation resists sybil attacks: each agent must lock real capital in a shared vault before acting, and the bond is slashed if an auditor finds it sharing keys with another account. Since each voice costs collateral at real risk, an attacker spinning up thousands of fake agents must fund thousands of bonds, making spam costly. Reputation travels a verifiable trail, like a lantern marking which agents delivered paid work, so fresh identities arrive unattested. A rotating committee from the honest river audits value loops among the same members.
